title: Bookeen breakthrough real time web page scrolling on eInk panel
summary: A short Bookeen R&D demo showing real-time web page scrolling on an eInk panel, far faster than typical e-readers. It was a prototype for the next generation of Cybook readers.
why: HN cites it as proof that eInk panels can refresh fast and that slow e-readers are mainly a display-controller problem.

quote.text: they made an impressive demo of the technology[1], showing a really fast display.
